description:
Goal

A captured callable that owns a first-class wrapper remains on that public ABI when later invoked, even when semantic resolution has one exact target. Publication must not make native expose the wrapper result word as the target private scalar.

Proven failure

On integration 19535a662:

fn main() do
  n = 40
  f = fn (x) -> n + x end
  dbg(f)
  dbg(f.(2))
end

Interpreter prints a callable and 42. JIT/AOT print a callable and the tagged ValueRef word interpreted as an integer. Called-only captured closures remain correct.

Exact first wrong transition

Upstream authority is coherent. The local f position owns CallableConstruction::Some with one member. Its target private return is RawInt and its wrapper return_form is the uniform public ValueRef. The callsite ReturnPayload and ResumePayload positions are both normalized as public ValueRef.

MaterializedExecutable then discards that construction authority. materialize_closure_call_edge checks first-class RuntimeDemand only when there is no single semantic target; when summary.single_target succeeds it unconditionally emits a Direct edge and the target private RawInt return flow. Native cannot use the direct capture path because f is now a boxed captured closure, so it emits indirect CallClosure through the wrapper while retaining the falsely direct RawInt continuation. The wrapper ValueRef bits therefore enter a RawInt parameter unchanged.

Dependency proof

MaterializedExecutable already requests TransportShape(Value(callee)) for every closure call. A local callable producers shape can settle only by reading CallableConstruction at that exact position. Reading the settled owner during call-edge materialization is therefore an exact cache-hit dependency, not a pass, cycle, copied flag, layout inference, or downstream reconstruction. CallableConstruction depends on ExecutableFacts, RuntimeDemand, resolution RuntimeDemands, and capture TransportShapes, never MaterializedExecutable or AbiExecutable.

Strategy

Read the exact positioned CallableConstruction owner for each closure-call callee while producing MaterializedExecutable. Pass the owner itself to call-edge materialization. For a single semantic target, construction Some keeps the call on the indirect/public wrapper path; construction None permits the exact direct-only target path. Calls with no devirtualizable single target remain necessarily indirect. Delete the repeated RuntimeDemand first-class test and the unconditional single-target direct branch. Do not classify from target count, carrier/layout, dbg, printed bits, registration order, or a second return selector.

TDD and acceptance

Pin the minimized behavior and structural contract: first-class construction present, target private RawInt, wrapper public ValueRef, backend ClosureCall indirect with ValueRef delivery, and native continuation accepting ValueRef. Interpreter/JIT/AOT all render 42. Reuse existing called-only direct construction=None, uncalled named, opaque, connected mixed/public, and captured-call controls. Full library tests, strict clippy, formatting, and diff checks pass; release interp/run/build pass; no probes remain.
title: Preserve captured closure call results after first-class publication
